question: Hideki Yukawa, who received the Nobel Prize in 1949, is well known for which discovery?
solution:
The correct answer is the **Theory of nuclear forces.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hideki Yukawa** discovered that there is a **simple relation** between the **range of forces and the mass of corresponding particles**.
 
• He estimated the **range** from known experimental data and found that the** new particles should be about 200 times heavier than the electrons.**
 
• This theory of him named** mesons,** which are **held together by nuclear forces** fetched him the **Nobel prize in Physics in the year 1949**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the theory proposed by him, the **nuclear forces can be traced back to an exchange of mesons between the nucleons.** These are continuously emitting and absorbing mesons.
 
• Thus, this theory also explained the **interaction between a proton and a neutron** in a nucleus.
